Vacancy for the post of Dean
Tuesday, 11 April 2023
3446 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the post of Dean (1 Open) at MGIMS with the prescribed proforma with all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates which should reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by 30/04/2023. The appointment would be temporary for the period as approved by MUHS or till the next regular Selection Committee of MUHS meets whichever is earlier and as per MUHS direction 1/2017.
Qualification & Experience :
Should possess the recognised post graduate medical qualification from a recognized Institution with a minimum of ten years teaching experience as Professor / Associate Professor in the relevant department of Medical College / Institute, out of which at least five years should be as Professor in a department.
PAY SCALE  :
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
